run_fused_recurrent_kda: run the fused recurrent KDA forward pass with q, k, v, g, beta tensors and scale parameter
run_chunk_kda: run the chunked KDA forward pass with q, k, v, g, beta, initial_state and optional cu_seqlens for variable lengths
compute_chunk_kda_scaled_dot_kkt: compute beta times K times K-transpose using chunked kernel with optional cumulative gate and variable-length support
run_rms_norm_gated: run RMS normalization with gated activation and optional residual connection on input tensor
run_fused_kda_gate: run the KDA gate forward pass applying softplus with beta and threshold parameters to produce gated output
